notes.title: The Zombie Slayers – Demo Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
We’ve rolled out a new update to The Zombie Slayers demo! Based on player feedback, we've made a number of changes to improve your experience.

The Baby mechanic is now active in the demo! This tiny companion stays by your side, protects you, and occasionally demands milk with zero patience. Parenting meets survival !!!

🔧 Here’s what’s included:

👶 A baby added! – Yes, you read that right. A baby now follows and protects you loyally. But beware: when it gets tired, you'll need to feed it milk. No milk, no help.
🎥 Camera system updated – The new camera is smoother and easier on the eyes. Prefer the old style? You can switch between both in the settings.
🐞 Bug fixes & better performance – The game runs more fluidly thanks to core fixes.
💬 Improved onboarding – New hints and clearer instructions help players get into the game more smoothly.
🧍‍♂️🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Singleplayer and Multiplayer modes separated – More organized and streamlined mode selection.
⚖️ Gameplay rebalanced – Combat and resource systems are now more fair and fun.
🎮 Usable items added – You can now find and use new defensive and support gear to help you survive.
🖥️ UI polished – Cleaner, sharper interface for a better overall experience.
🎨 Visual improvements – Updated visuals add more atmosphere to the world.


Try the updated demo now and let us know what you think! Don’t forget to Wishlist The Zombie Slayers and support the team.

💬 Join our Discord to share feedback, meet the community, and stay updated!
